rationale: The position is currently underwater (-1.12%) and trading below the session VWAP ($65.91) and 9-EMA ($65.96), indicating that the initial mean-reversion thesis has stalled and sellers are in control. However, the price remains well above the invalidation level ($64.05) and the opening low ($64.10), and the lack of new negative news suggests the dip may still be absorbing selling pressure rather than breaking down. Closing now would lock in a loss near the bottom of the recent pullback without a clear breakdown signal, while holding allows the trade to either recover to VWAP or hit the stop if support fails.
